crossRefs.note: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.
“Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

parallels.note: “Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

translations.web: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?
translations.bsb: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
translations.kjv: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
translations.asv: And which of you by being anxious can add a cubit unto the measure of his life?
